name: hey-woo-monorepo
description: Monorepo for WooCommerce for Claude, Hey Woo, and shared commerce abilities.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:woocommerce-for-claude && pnpm run build:hey-woo
scripts.build:production: pnpm run build:production:woocommerce-for-claude && pnpm run build:production:hey-woo
scripts.plugin-zip: composer install --working-dir=plugins/woocommerce-for-claude --no-dev --prefer-dist --no-progress --no-interaction --optimize-autoloader && pnpm --dir plugins/woocommerce-for-claude run plugin-zip && cp plugins/woocommerce-for-claude/woocommerce-for-claude.zip woocommerce-for-claude.zip
scripts.hey-woo-plugin-zip: composer install --working-dir=plugins/hey-woo --no-dev --prefer-dist --no-progress --no-interaction --optimize-autoloader && pnpm --dir plugins/hey-woo run plugin-zip && cp plugins/hey-woo/hey-woo.zip hey-woo.zip
